title: Improve dial note contrast
prompt:
In lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart, replace the exact line `                      textTertiary: context.mp.textTertiary,` with `                      textTertiary: context.mp.textSecondary,`. Then replace this exact block:
```
      final color =
          (isCurrent
                  ? MonoPulseColors.accentOrange
                  : isInScale
                  ? MonoPulseColors.white
                  : textTertiary)
              .withValues(alpha: isCurrent ? 1.0 : 0.5);
```
with:
```
      final color = isCurrent ? MonoPulseColors.accentOrange : textTertiary;
```
This gives inactive note names and their tick marks the theme secondary text color while keeping the current note's orange emphasis. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'textTertiary: context.mp.textSecondary,' lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && rg -Fq 'final color = isCurrent ? MonoPulseColors.accentOrange : textTertiary;' lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart

title: Improve outer tick contrast
prompt:
In lib/widgets/tuner/tick_marks.dart, replace the exact lines:
```
        tickPaint
          ..color = isMajor ? palette.borderDefault : palette.borderSubtle,
```
with:
```
        tickPaint..color = palette.textSecondary,
```
This gives the outer dial tick marks the theme secondary text color in both themes. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'tickPaint..color = palette.textSecondary,' lib/widgets/tuner/tick_marks.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/tuner/tick_marks.dart
